about: The Our additions section of /restoration/ (Austin 2026-11-25, #699, G1308): each addition of ours that has a Tiny Speck original, the original beside ours. Every word players read is here; tools/made-art/build-data.mjs writes them into public/restoration/made.json `ours` with each picture's size read from its file, and the site's groddle/restoration-ours block draws them. `invention` names the entry in tools/inventions/inventions.json; every kept visual invention there names a compare entry here, "made" (the Made for Groddle band shows it) or says in `noCompare` why it has none (tests/inventions-register.test.js). Pictures under public/assets/made-art/compare/ are composed by tools/made-art/compare-art.mjs and recorded in `files` with their sha256; anything else is a shipped file of the game. `parts` steps the compare popup through pairs; `partsFrom` builds them from the game's data. Only Tiny Speck's CC0 art and our own: never a player's snap, footage or video frame.

entries.name: Stat icons
entries.caption: One icon and one colour for each stat, the same in the top bar, in speech bubbles, in the amounts that float up and on the reward card. Glitch drew each stat its own way in each place: a bolt beside the energy gauge, a green battery in a speech bubble. A player asked for one of each, so these were drawn for Groddle in its flat style, each after the Tiny Speck picture it stands in for. Later the same player asked for Tiny Speck's pictures back; Austin kept ours and gave the coin the two strokes of Tiny Speck's currant sign.

entries.name: Reimagined clothes
entries.caption: Tiny Speck left {count} clothing files as greyscale masters that Glitch never sold, so they never had colours. Groddle sells them in colours borrowed from the piece they match, or chosen from the same palette where none does, and marks them Reimagined in the wardrobe. The drawing is Tiny Speck's; only the colours are ours.

original.label: Tiny Speck's files as they are, in greyscale
original.alt: A Glitch in a white banana hat beside one in a white teapot dress, both drawn in greys.

image.label: Ours, in the colours we gave them
image.alt: The same two Glitches: the banana hat now yellow, the teapot dress blue and white with gold trim.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: Each one is sold and worn like any other piece of clothing, with a Reimagined tag that says where its colours come from.
